The '''Barlok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Marcol sector/Legends|Marcol sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]]. It was between three and six days of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].
